subject: Mythology
title: Kappa: The Water Goblins
description: One-minute skill: Kappa: The Water Goblins.

hook.text: Kappa are green, turtle-shelled water goblins with a dish of water on their heads that gives them all their power.

buildup.text: They lurk in rivers and ponds, grabbing swimmers and pulling them under. Parents use kappa stories to warn children.

discovery.text: Kappa are obsessed with good manners. If you bow to one, it will bow back, spilling the water from its head.

twist.text: Without the water on its head, a kappa loses all power. Politeness literally defeats the monster.

climax.text: Some stories show kappa befriending humans and teaching them medicine or farming in exchange for cucumbers.

punchline.text: In Japan, you can defeat a water demon just by being polite.

quiz.question: How can you defeat a kappa according to Japanese folklore?
options: Strike it with a wooden sword blessed by a priest
Bow to it, causing it to bow back and spill the water from its head
Offer it a fish as a distraction and run away
